subject: CODE-SET clause
notes: GR2 - on successful OPEN the coded character set used to represent alphanumeric data on the storage medium is alphabet-name-1's. The set is established for the CONNECTOR and constant thereafter, so it is registered once beside the connector (FileConnector.CodeSet, the FileConnector.NationalRecordArea pattern) rather than re-derived per record; for an identity set nothing is registered at all and the record channel is unchanged byte for byte. The EBCDIC golden observes it in both directions: the same physical file read back through a description carrying NO CODE-SET clause yields the medium's own code units (GR7's default), which is what shows the clause established a DIFFERENT set for the first connector.
